name: trackiq-amazon-branded-search
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Branded vs. Non-Branded Search
summary: Splits every Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands search term into branded, competitor, product-targeting and generic buckets, then shows where the ad money really goes — how much is spent on shoppers who already typed the brand, what generic search returns once brand is taken out, whether competitor conquesting pays — and checks the brand's purchase share on its own name before calling brand spend defence or waste.
changelog: Counts product targeting on the brand's own ASINs as branded, merges near-duplicate queries, stops paging once 97% of channel spend is covered, and reads Search Query Performance week by week as a purchase share covering organic and paid, marking thin weeks.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
